# Aegis Coworking

> Official website of Aegis Coworking, a coworking and business centre located in Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), Addax Tower, Al Reem Island, Abu Dhabi, UAE.

Aegis Coworking provides flexible workspace solutions for freelancers, startups, SMEs, and international businesses operating in Abu Dhabi. Services include hot desks, dedicated desks, private offices, virtual offices, meeting rooms, presentation rooms, and coworking day passes.

## Location

- Addax Tower, Al Reem Island
- Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM)
- Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

## Services

- Hot Desks
- Dedicated Desks
- Private Offices
- Virtual Offices
- Meeting Rooms
- Presentation Rooms
- Coworking Day Passes

## Pricing Overview

- **Hot Desk:** From AED 1,000/month
- **Dedicated Desk:** From AED 1,150/month (includes ADGM-eligible registered address, 24/7 access and lockable storage)
- **Private Office:** From AED 4,500/month (configurable for teams of 1–20+)
- **Day Pass:** AED 100 (9 AM–6 PM) or AED 150 (24-hour access)
- **Virtual Office:** Basic, Premium and Enterprise packages available (request a quote)
- **Meeting Room:** Hourly booking available (membership credits included)
- **Presentation Room:** Hourly and half-day rental available (request a quote)

## Key Facts

- Located inside Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM).
- Dedicated desks, private offices and virtual offices include a registered business address suitable for ADGM company registration and licence renewal.
- Dedicated desks and private offices include secure 24/7 building access.
- Day passes and hot desks require no long-term contract.
- Meeting room credits are included with membership plans.
- Presentation room accommodates up to 50 attendees with 4K display, professional audio and live-streaming capability.
